description: This PHP source file defines web service functions for SuiteCRM, including methods to retrieve modified relationship data, entries, and attendees, with registration of these functions for SOAP access.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Class used for handling SOAP error states and messages.

methods.name: sync_get_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves a list of modified relationship records within a date range, supporting pagination and filtering.

methods.name: get_modified_entries
methods.description: Fetches modified entries for a specified module and list of IDs, returning data in XML base64-encoded format.

methods.name: get_attendee_list
methods.description: Returns a list of attendees (users and contacts) associated with a specific meeting or call, encoded in base64 XML.
